_comment: Single source of truth for AI usage limits, read identically by functions/ai/quota.js (Node require) and src/utils/aiUsageConfig.js (Vite JSON import — no build step needed for either). To introduce Free/Beta/Premium plans for real, set users/{uid}.plan in Firestore to one of the keys under 'plans' — no code changes required. Anyone without a plan field falls back to 'defaultPlan'.

global._comment: A project-wide daily ceiling across every user combined — the circuit breaker that protects against a cost spike from a bug, a viral moment, or coordinated abuse spread across many accounts that are each individually within their own limit. Raise this deliberately as real usage grows.
